reason: The tracks are meant to spread the wheels’ load, so placing them on the soft drift seems like the direct way to build the crossing.
expectation: I expect the gravel-filled tracks to make the drift firmer for the rover, though the crossing may need another step.

alternatives.reason: The winch and rock anchor could help pull the rover across, but I want to establish a stable surface first.

effect: The tracks made a gravel crossing; the winch at the rock anchor is the only remaining combination.
reaction: Placing the tracks was a straightforward, satisfying first step.
reason: The winch is the only available combination and may help the rover get across.
expectation: I expect to secure the winch to the rock anchor and use it to assist the crossing, though I do not know exactly what the result will be.

effect: The winch created an anchored recovery line, which can now be combined with the crossing.
reaction: The anchor setup makes practical sense.
reason: This is the only available combination, and it should bring the recovery line and stable crossing together.
expectation: I expect the line to help the rover cross the gravel safely, though I do not know exactly how the game will describe it.

effect: The crossing brought the rover and secured cold case onto firm rock within reach of the sheltered ice face, completing the chapter’s goal.
reaction: Seeing the tracks and winch work together was satisfying, though the sequence was predictable.

mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the recovery line with the gravel crossing was most worthwhile: the result showed how steady pulling and supported tracks helped the rover reach firm ground with its cold case.

leastWorthwhile.text: Anchoring the winch was practical but fairly routine, especially as it was the only available combination at that point.

surprise.text: Nothing in this chapter particularly surprised me; the crossing worked much as I expected.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary. The tracks supported the wheels, and the anchored line helped pull the rover across.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because the sheltered ice face is now within reach, and I am curious whether the cold case can preserve a whole piece of the band.
